name: navin-phase1-acceptance
description: W05 Phase 1 acceptance matrix. Executors that need disposable infrastructure or packaged artifacts report BLOCKED or NOT_RUN rather than faking success.

entries.name: Evidence-class ladder blocks weak evidence
entries.claim: Unit evidence can never satisfy external or desktop requirements.

entries.name: SHA-256 index verifies clean files and detects tampering
Production deny guard rejects production endpoints
Command receipt capture on the local runtime
Disposable mail target TCP reachability
entries.claim: The local disposable delivery port accepts a TCP connection.

entries.name: Real SMTP banner and EHLO exchange
entries.claim: A real SMTP dialogue returns a 220 banner and 250 EHLO against the disposable engine.

entries.name: Real IMAP greeting and CAPABILITY exchange
entries.claim: A real IMAP dialogue returns an OK greeting and CAPABILITY against the disposable engine.

entries.name: Browser E2E of the Mail surface
entries.claim: The Mail web surface renders and passes a scripted browser run.

entries.name: Packaged Windows Desktop proof
entries.claim: The packaged NSIS Desktop artifact launches on Windows.

entries.name: External DNS evidence for a disposable domain
entries.note: Requires an explicitly allow-listed disposable domain; disabled until one exists.
entries.claim: Public MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC records are published for an authorized disposable domain.

entries.name: External deliverability probe
entries.note: Requires an authorized external probe; disabled until resources exist.
entries.claim: External inbox placement is verified with authorized disposable resources.

entries.name: navind health endpoint
entries.note: Executor is not implemented yet. Must report BLOCKED, never PASS.
entries.claim: The navind daemon reports healthy from persisted state.

entries.name: Evidence survives daemon restart
entries.note: Optional and disabled until the daemon exists; must report NOT_RUN.
entries.claim: Audit and evidence survive a navind restart.
